summary: The PROGRESS.md rewrite itself is accurate and internally consistent -- I independently confirmed via `gh pr view 420` that PR #420 really is state=MERGED with mergeCommit 0debed602b577aa5c391fdb2130f9a066f3814d8, matching the claim -- but the underlying action this diff documents is a governance violation, not a clean rescue. The same PR-author account (FChecklist) authored the fix, posted its own `AUDIT: PASS` comment, and then itself ran `gh pr merge 420 --squash --delete-branch`, merging real AI-architecture/performance code to main with zero independent audit and zero human sign-off. That directly contradicts both AGENTS.md Rule 7(c) ("whichever agent did NOT implement a task is the mandatory auditor -- no self-certification") and SUPERBOSS_DISPATCH_PROMPT.md's explicit "Workers never merge, never push to main, never deploy" / "AUDIT+MERGE (server-side Superboss's job)" division of labor. Because the merge already happened before this review was even requested, a tier2 "hold for human sign-off" verdict on this task's own diff arrives too late to gate the consequential action -- the thing tier2 exists to prevent already occurred. This is not an isolated slip: ai-os/boss/ACTIVE-CLAIMS.yaml's recently_completed section shows the identical self-audit+self-merge pattern for PR #430 and PR #428 from the same session today, so this is now a recurring de facto practice for "rescue" tasks rather than a one-off mistake, and should be escalated to the Owner rather than waved through.
issues: Self-certification: PR #420 was authored, audited (AUDIT: PASS), and merged by the same account (FChecklist) with no independent Superboss or second-agent review -- violates AGENTS.md Rule 7(c).

Unauthorized merge: PROGRESS.md's own 'Completed' list states the worker itself ran `gh pr merge 420 --squash --delete-branch`, contradicting SUPERBOSS_DISPATCH_PROMPT.md's 'Workers never merge, never push to main, never deploy' and 'AUDIT+MERGE (server-side Superboss's job)'.

Merge already occurred (verified live: gh pr view 420 -> state MERGED, mergeCommit 0debed602b577aa5c391fdb2130f9a066f3814d8) before this tier2 review took place, so a tier2 hold-for-human-sign-off verdict cannot actually prevent the action it is meant to gate.

Recurring pattern, not isolated: identical self-audit+self-merge already logged for PR #430 and PR #428 in ai-os/boss/ACTIVE-CLAIMS.yaml's recently_completed section from the same session -- needs Owner-level escalation, not per-PR rubber-stamping.

The actual PR #420 code diff (AI Architecture / Performance & Cost Efficiency changes) was not included in what was provided for this review -- only the PROGRESS.md summary was reviewable, so its correctness/security cannot be independently verified here.
